title: 1 Chronicles Bible Quiz - Chapter 19
description: Ten questions on 1 Chronicles 19: Hanun's insult to David's messengers and Israel's victory over Ammon and the Syrians.

questions.text: Why did David want to show kindness to Hanun the son of Nahash?
questions.explanation: David said, "I will show kindness to Hanun the son of Nahash, because his father showed kindness to me."

answers.text: Hanun's father had shown kindness to him
Nathan the prophet told him to

questions.text: What did the princes of Ammon claim David's servants had really come to do?
questions.explanation: The princes said, "Haven't his servants come to you to search, to overthrow, and to spy out the land?"

answers.text: To bring gifts for the burial of Nahash
To ask for a treaty between Israel and Ammon
To search, to overthrow and to spy out the land
To demand tribute from the children of Ammon

questions.text: What did Hanun do to David's servants?
questions.explanation: Hanun shaved them, cut off their garments in the middle at their buttocks, and sent them away.

answers.text: He shaved them and cut off their garments
He gave them gifts and sent them home
He killed them with the sword

questions.text: Where did David tell the humiliated men to stay until their beards had grown?
questions.explanation: The king said, "Stay at Jericho until your beards have grown, and then return."

questions.text: How much did Hanun and the children of Ammon send to hire chariots and horsemen?
questions.explanation: They sent one thousand talents of silver to hire chariots and horsemen out of Mesopotamia, Aram-maacah and Zobah.

questions.text: Near which place did the king of Maacah and his people encamp?
questions.explanation: Verse 7 says the king of Maacah and his people came and encamped near Medeba.

questions.text: To whom did Joab commit the rest of the people to face the children of Ammon?
questions.explanation: Joab committed the rest of the people into the hand of Abishai his brother.

questions.text: What did Joab say at the end of his words of encouragement?
questions.explanation: Joab said, "Be courageous, and let's be strong for our people and for the cities of our God. May Yahweh do that which seems good to him."

answers.text: "Let us flee back to Jerusalem before night."
"May Yahweh do that which seems good to him."
"Spare the king of Maacah and his people."

questions.text: Who was the captain of Hadadezer's army whom David killed?
questions.explanation: The Syrians came out with Shophach the captain of the army of Hadadezer leading them, and David killed Shophach.

questions.text: What did the servants of Hadadezer do when they saw they were defeated by Israel?
questions.explanation: They made peace with David and served him, and the Syrians would not help the children of Ammon any more.

answers.text: They fled to the king of Ammon for help
They made peace with David and served him
They hired another army out of Egypt
They gathered and attacked Jerusalem at night
